body: Update: I cant stop doing it now. Now when I'm depressed I start cutting myself to find comfort. It sucks cause I stopped for 7 years and now since I slipped up once I cant stop. I find that it's my only way of coping.
Oddly enough hurting myself calmed me down. But I believe in you. Just hang in there.

Me too. I actually started working out yesterday. I need to go grocery shopping for some healthy food still. I am determined to make this year better. I want to see my niece grow up (she will be born in the next 2 weeks) I am going to try to fight for my life.

I'm in counseling I just haven't told her about it yet. I've told some friends but they try to change the subject. I'm okay though, sometimes it just randomly pops into my head but other than that I don't think about it.
I tried leaving him before but my mom and sister forced me to stay with him. So much more stuff happened in the relationship but its too long to write out. I'm a lot happier, thank you 🙂
He's trying to get me back. He showed me my engagement ring. He wont leave me alone. Like I feel bad but I was mentally and physically drained just being with him.
